name: Building Your Reading Habit
equipment: A book you are currently reading
instructions: Reconnect with why you wanted to read more in the first place -- a concrete reason sustains a habit longer than a vague goal.
Swap one low-value screen habit (a specific app, a specific time slot) directly for reading time this week.
Notice what time of day you actually have energy to focus, and protect that slot for reading rather than hoping to "find time."
Watch today's video for a fresh take on building the habit.
